qualifier: stimulated cAMP production (forskolin, dopamine receptor, adenylate cyclase activation), without PDE1/DARPP-32 turnover
name: Stimulated cAMP production activating PKA and CREB
rationale: All members describe adenylate cyclase stimulation raising cAMP to activate PKA and CREB; unlike its superset confusable it lacks cAMP degradation, PDE1 and DARPP-32 feedback, and unlike the CaMK confusables it routes through adenylate cyclase.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis and PDE1 degradation with DARPP-32 feedback
name: cAMP turnover and PKA-CREB signaling with PDE1/DARPP-32 feedback
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis, PKA activation and CREB phosphorylation, and uniquely add cAMP catabolism, Cam-PDE1 activation, DARPP-32 events and negative regulation of cAMP/PKA, which the core activation theme and the inhibitory/CaMK confusables lack.

qualifier: adrenaline alpha-2 receptor via G-alpha-z only
name: Adrenaline alpha-2 receptor and G-alpha-z cAMP-lowering signaling
rationale: All four members are the adrenaline alpha-2 receptor / Gz arm that inhibits adenylate cyclase, without the PLC-calcium, IP3 and secretion-restraint members of the broader inhibitory confusable or the adrenoceptor/insulin members of the other.

core: Inhibitory G protein control of cAMP
qualifier: with PLC-IP3 calcium signaling and restraint of exocytosis/secretion
name: Inhibitory G protein cAMP and PLC-calcium signaling restraining secretion
rationale: Members combine Gi/Gz alpha-2 adenylate cyclase inhibition with G protein calcium signaling, PLC/IP3 regulation and negative regulation of exocytosis, epinephrine secretion and amino acid transport, which the minimal alpha-2 theme and the cAMP-PKA confusables lack.

qualifier: leucine and glucose starvation, no AKT-TSC input
name: Leucine and glucose starvation control of mTORC1
rationale: All members concern leucine/amino acid and glucose/energy (LKB1-AMPK) signals regulating TORC1; unlike its superset confusable it lacks AKT inhibition of TSC, methionine response and the TSC2/LKB1 growth module.

qualifier: adds AKT-TSC2 growth-factor input and methionine sensing
name: Nutrient, energy and AKT-TSC2 growth-factor inputs to mTORC1
rationale: Members cover amino acid, glucose and LKB1-AMPK energy sensing of mTORC1 plus AKT inhibition of TSC and the TSC2/LKB1 growth-restraint module, which distinguishes it from the leucine/glucose-only theme and the metabolic/methylation confusables.

qualifier: with tau tangle assembly and microglial activation
name: Amyloid and tau aggregation with microglial activation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid fibril formation and APP synthesis/catabolism and additionally include neurofibrillary tangle assembly, microglial activation and glucosylceramide catabolism, which the APP/fibril-only theme lacks; it lacks the amyloid-beta clearance members of other confusables.

core: Amyloid fibril and APP level regulation
qualifier: bidirectional control, without tau, microglia or amyloid-beta clearance
name: Bidirectional regulation of amyloid fibrils and APP abundance
rationale: All members are positive/negative regulation of amyloid fibril formation and of APP biosynthesis/catabolism (with obsolete amide-metabolism terms), lacking the tau, microglial and amyloid-beta clearance members of its confusables.

qualifier: including APC truncation and AMER1 scaffold loss
name: Beta-catenin escape from destruction via APC, AMER1, AXIN, CTNNB1 mutants
rationale: Members are the beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and its cancer mutants, including APC truncations and AMER1 deletions/truncations that the phosphosite-only theme lacks, and none of the TCF, DVL or Notch members of other confusables.

qualifier: CTNNB1 phosphosite, GSK3 and AXIN mutants, without APC/AMER1
name: CTNNB1 phosphosite and GSK3/AXIN mutants blocking beta-catenin phosphorylation
rationale: Members are the beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade with CTNNB1 S33/S37/T41/S45, GSK3beta and AXIN missense mutants; it lacks the APC truncation and AMER1 members of its superset and the downstream TCF/DVL members of other confusables.

qualifier: prefoldin handoff of nascent chains, no post-chaperonin tubulin cofactors
name: Prefoldin handoff and CCT/TRiC folding of nascent cytoskeletal proteins
rationale: All members describe prefoldin transfer and CCT/TRiC-mediated folding of actin and tubulin during biosynthesis; unlike its superset it lacks the post-chaperonin tubulin cofactor and de novo folding members.

qualifier: extended through post-chaperonin tubulin cofactor maturation
name: CCT/TRiC folding through post-chaperonin tubulin cofactor maturation
rationale: Members cover prefoldin/CCT-TRiC folding of actin and tubulin plus the post-chaperonin tubulin folding pathway and de novo folding, which distinguish it from the CCT-only theme and from tubulin modification or telomerase confusables.

qualifier: mitotic release at sister separation, without establishment or meiosis
name: Mitotic centromeric cohesion release at sister chromatid separation
rationale: The four members are mitotic centromeric cohesion, its regulation, resolution and sister separation; it lacks the establishment, maintenance and meiotic cohesion members of its superset and the spindle/APC-C members of others.

qualifier: from establishment through release, mitotic and meiotic
name: Centromeric cohesion establishment through release in mitosis and meiosis
rationale: Members span establishment, maintenance, mitotic and meiotic centromeric cohesion, resolution and separation, the establishment/meiotic members distinguishing it from the mitotic-release-only theme.

core: Cerebellar cortex development and motor behavior
qualifier: layer formation and locomotor behavior, without proprioception or motor neuron survival
name: Cerebellar cortical lamination and locomotor behavior
rationale: Members are cerebellar Purkinje/granular layer formation, Bergmann glia and granule precursor proliferation with walking, righting and motor learning; it lacks the proprioception, motor neuron and neural RNA-binding members of its superset.

qualifier: adds motor neuron survival, proprioception and voluntary movement
name: Cerebellar and motor neuron development with proprioceptive motor control
rationale: Members cover cerebellar layer formation and locomotor behavior plus proprioception, voluntary movement, motor neuron apoptosis control, collateral sprouting and hindbrain differentiation, which the lamination-only theme and brainstem confusables lack.

qualifier: prophase-prometaphase, without general nucleosome assembly
name: Prophase-prometaphase condensation and CENP-A centromere loading
rationale: All members are mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation or CENP-A deposition at centromeres; it lacks the replication-dependent chromatin assembly and nucleosome organization members of its superset.

qualifier: replication-coupled nucleosome assembly with CENP-A deposition
name: Replication-coupled nucleosome assembly, CENP-A deposition and chromosome condensation
rationale: Members add replication-dependent chromatin assembly, nucleosome organization and protein localization to chromatin to CENP-A deposition and condensation, distinguishing it from the condensation/CENP-A-only theme and the cohesion confusables.

qualifier: cohesin loading and chromatin looping through cohesion release
name: Cohesin loading, chromatin looping and sister cohesion cycle
rationale: Members span cohesin loading, chromatin looping, establishment, maintenance and resolution of sister chromatid cohesion; it lacks the negative cohesion regulation and mitotic-phase members of its superset and the condensation/CENP-A members of others.

qualifier: with negative regulation of cohesion and mitotic-phase modules
name: Mitotic-phase cohesin cycle including negative regulation of cohesion
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, looping, establishment and resolution of cohesion plus negative regulation of sister chromatid cohesion and mitotic-phase cell cycle modules, which the plain cohesin-cycle theme lacks.

qualifier: COPII cargo export and COPI retrieval, without intra-Golgi traffic
name: COPII cargo export and COPI retrieval at the ER-Golgi interface
rationale: Members are COPII cargo loading/export, vesicle targeting and tethering to cis-Golgi and COPI budding/retrograde return; it lacks the intra-Golgi and COPI anterograde members of its superset and the ER translocation members of others.

qualifier: extended to intra-Golgi and COPI anterograde transport
name: ER-Golgi and intra-Golgi COPII/COPI vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover COPII export, tethering and COPI retrograde traffic plus intra-Golgi traffic and COPI anterograde transport, which the ER-Golgi interface theme lacks; it lacks Golgi organization members of other confusables.

qualifier: in early B cell development and hypermutation, without class switching
name: APOBEC/AID deaminases in B cell development, hypermutation and viral restriction
rationale: Members are DNA cytosine deamination and C-to-U editing, somatic hypermutation, V(D)J recombination, B cell lineage commitment and APOBEC3G antiviral restriction; it lacks the IgA/IgG class-switching and anti-HIV members of its superset.

qualifier: including IgA/IgG class switching and APOBEC3G anti-HIV restriction
name: AID/APOBEC deamination including class switching and anti-HIV restriction
rationale: Members add isotype switching to IgA/IgG, APOBEC3G resistance to HIV-1 and viral frameshifting to deaminase-driven hypermutation and B cell development, distinguishing it from the theme without class switching and from HIV life-cycle and ADAR confusables.

qualifier: chylomicron, VLDL, LDL, HDL from intestinal absorption, without sterol-transporter or vitamin E members
name: Chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL lifecycle from intestinal absorption
rationale: All members concern dietary lipid digestion/absorption and assembly, remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL; it lacks the ABCG5/8 sitosterolemia and vitamin E members of its superset and the HDL assembly/ABCA1 members of another confusable.
